name: HR People Analytics
description: Workforce data including performance, tenure, and compensation

executiveSummary.overview: Workforce of 25 employees across 5 departments shows average satisfaction of 7.2/10 and performance of 83.8%. Attrition rate of 24% (6 employees) is above the 15% industry benchmark and concentrated in junior roles.
executiveSummary.topCategory: Engineering leads in compensation (avg $128K) and performance (avg 90.5). Finance shows the highest tenure-to-satisfaction ratio. Sales Manager roles have the highest performance scores at 91-96.
executiveSummary.risk: 6 of 25 employees (24%) indicated attrition — 5 have tenure under 2 years and satisfaction scores of 5-6/10. Junior roles are the primary attrition risk, with Sales SDR and Engineering junior engineers most affected.
executiveSummary.opportunities: High-performing senior employees (satisfaction 8-9) represent retention assets. Structured mentorship pairing seniors with junior staff could reduce first-year attrition by an estimated 30-40%.
executiveSummary.recommendation: Implement a 90-day onboarding satisfaction survey for all new hires. Review compensation for SDR role ($62K is 18% below market). Create clear career progression paths for junior engineering and sales roles.

smartAlerts.title: Attrition Risk Elevated

aiInsights.text: Attrition is concentrated in employees with tenure under 2 years and satisfaction scores below 6 — a clear early-warning signal for targeted retention programs.
Sales Manager roles show 91-96 performance scores, suggesting strong leadership — consider expanding their direct reports or territory.
Satisfaction and performance are strongly correlated (r≈0.82) — investing in employee experience directly impacts output quality.
SDR compensation at $62K is estimated 18% below market — this likely contributes to the 100% attrition rate in that role.
Finance department shows zero attrition with average tenure of 4.7 years — studying its culture and management practices could inform company-wide retention strategy.
